summary: GRI 402 covers an organization's consultative practices with employees and their representatives, including how it communicates significant operational changes. Collective bargaining is part of these practices. It contains one disclosure on minimum notice periods.

questions.text: Describe the actual and potential, negative and positive impacts of the organization on the economy, environment and people, including impacts on their human rights, in relation to labor/management relations.
questions.hint: Cover both actual and potential impacts, negative and positive, including impacts on human rights.

questions.text: Is the organization involved with the negative impacts related to labor/management relations through its own activities or as a result of its business relationships? Describe those activities or business relationships.
questions.hint: State whether involvement is through the organization's activities or through its business relationships, and describe them.

questions.text: Describe the organization's policies or commitments regarding labor/management relations.
questions.hint: Describe the policies or commitments that apply to this material topic.

questions.text: Describe the actions taken to manage labor/management relations and the related impacts, including (i) actions to prevent or mitigate potential negative impacts, (ii) actions to address actual negative impacts, including actions to provide for or cooperate in their remediation, and (iii) actions to manage actual and potential positive impacts.
questions.hint: Cover i. prevention or mitigation of potential negative impacts; ii. addressing actual negative impacts, including remediation; iii. managing positive impacts.

questions.text: How does the organization track the effectiveness of the actions taken? Describe (i) the processes used, (ii) the goals, targets and indicators used to evaluate progress, (iii) the effectiveness of the actions, including progress toward goals and targets, and (iv) lessons learned and how they have been incorporated into operational policies and procedures.
questions.hint: Cover i. tracking processes; ii. goals, targets and indicators; iii. effectiveness and progress; iv. lessons learned and how they were incorporated.

questions.text: Describe how engagement with stakeholders has informed the actions taken (3-3-d) and how it has informed whether the actions have been effective (3-3-e).
questions.hint: Explain the role of stakeholder engagement in shaping actions and in judging their effectiveness.

disclosures.title: Minimum notice periods regarding operational changes

questions.text: What is the minimum number of weeks' notice typically provided to employees and their representatives prior to the implementation of significant operational changes that could substantially affect them?
questions.hint: Number of weeks' notice typically provided.

questions.text: For organizations with collective bargaining agreements, are the notice period and provisions for consultation and negotiation specified in the collective agreements?
questions.hint: Only applicable to organizations with collective bargaining agreements.
